title: Normalisation: a dual-norm-one n-vector that only sees an at most n-dimensional V is the unit n-vector of V
statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ, n := d+1, ζ₀ ∈ Λ_n(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P n) and V ⊆ ℝ^P a linear subspace with dim V ≤ n and orthogonal projection p_V (V.starProjection). Assume |ζ₀(β)| ≤ |β| for every n-covector β, ζ₀(β₁) = 1 for some n-covector β₁ with |β₁| ≤ 1 (|·| = covectorEuclideanNorm), and ζ₀(β) = ζ₀(β∘p_V) for every n-covector β, where (β∘p_V)(u) := β(p_Vu_0, …, p_Vu_d). Then dim V = n, and there is an orthonormal family v = (v_0, …, v_d) in ℝ^P with span{v_0, …, v_d} = V and ζ₀(β) = β(v_0, …, v_d) for every n-covector β.
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (ζ₀ : MultiVector P (d + 1)) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ V ≤ d + 1 → (∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), |ζ₀ β| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm β) → (∃ β : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), covectorEuclideanNorm β ≤ 1 ∧ ζ₀ β = 1) → (∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), ζ₀ β = ζ₀ (β.compContinuousLinearMap V.starProjection)) → Module.finrank ℝ V = d + 1 ∧ ∃ v : Fin (d + 1) → Euclid P, Orthonormal ℝ v ∧ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v) = V ∧ ∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), ζ₀ β = β v
